title: D-086 P2 - address and confirmation slice (web): one search/recovery area, identity comparison, a stable action area, concise map states and one source disclosure on the live /property flow, per the accepted P1 spec sections 5.1/5.2 - every AD/AC/M ledger row kept and proved
objective: Build the assessment's P2 slice on the LIVE search/confirm flow (/property without a bbl: ArchitectEntry PropertySearch -> AddressAutocomplete / AddressResolutionScreen -> AddressConfirmCard -> LotOutlineMap), following docs/design/ui-cleanup/P1-VISUAL-STATE-SPEC.md sections 5.1 and 5.2 (plus its vocabulary section 2, tokens section 3, preservation checklist section 7, cross-cutting section 8 and copy samples section 9): (1) ONE search/recovery area - suggestions with keyboard and touch and no auto-pick, the BBL alternative as a native <details>, a manual fallback that keeps the typed text and names the structured fields still needed, and a distinct recovery action per typed error category (source_unavailable, rejected, rate_limited, timeout, unavailable, no_match), spoken once by the existing announcer; (2) identity comparison on the confirm card - entered vs matched vs PLUTO representative address kept distinct, equal ids collapsing to one line; (3) a stable action area - a late PLUTO or record-address result never shifts Continue; (4) concise map states - rendered / unavailable / no WebGL / multiple or invalid parcel / basemap-only failure kept separate from parcel failure, with the 'Approximate - reference only' line; (5) one source disclosure per surface; (6) the environment badge + professional-review line visible at every width on the search surface (DB-083 f). Both city warnings stay verbatim ABOVE Continue; the section-29 disclaimer is rendered only through REQUIRED_DISCLAIMER (DB-083 b); per-reason recovery copy comes from the P0 ledger rows AD01-AD28 (DB-083 i). No backend or contract change; no-guess matching, raw warning placement and the optional record-address behaviour stay as they are.
business_reason: The owner asked for a more visually explanatory product (D-086). P2 is the first built slice of the accepted P1 design: the first two screens every analyst sees.
inputs: PRODUCER MODE (binding): you are an orchestrator-dispatched subagent producer working ONLY inside your task worktree (named in the dispatch). Commit your work there as ONE commit and report its sha. Never touch the primary checkout, the ledger, or any path outside allowed_paths.

REPORT DISCIPLINE (binding): reference files and line anchors, never embed long verbatim sections; every checkpoint carries IMPLEMENTATION; one concise evidence pass; the [OBSERVED]/[BLOCKED]/[PREDICTED] evidence-status form is the standard - route what you cannot run to harvest with an exact recipe, never predict-as-observed; explicit cwd on every recorded command.

OVERNIGHT (binding; D-089): the owner is asleep - never wait for or ask the owner anything. Put any question in the report's OPEN QUESTIONS section with your recommended answer; the orchestrator decides or queues it. Stop only for a Tier D item (legal/zoning approval, secrets, payment, licensing) and report it.

THIN CLIENT (binding; CODING_RULES): never run npm/npx/node locally - web tests prove ONLY in CI on the pushed head (the orchestrator pushes after harvest). Mark every web test result [PREDICTED] until CI; write TypeScript strict-clean: type DOM queries (querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>), write invalid-shape probes as `as unknown as T`, never .focus() synchronously across a remount (bump a nonce and focus in useEffect), never match focus by activeElement.textContent without excluding <body>, never commit an empty test file.

MEANING PRESERVATION (binding; the D-086-R003 discipline applied early): no existing disclosure, honest-gap statement, provenance note, or professional-review meaning is deleted or weakened; every changed user-visible string is listed in the report as before -> after with the meaning it protects; visual states never remap backend statuses; no number is computed in the presentation layer.

HONESTY (binding; D-073-R006/D-076-R002/D-083 vocabulary): proposal-derived geometry is 'Proposed - not a city record'; a generated option is a 'Generated building option'; nothing is ever labeled permitted, approved, or 'maximum allowed building'; no legal conclusion is drawn.

SPEC SOURCE (binding): docs/design/ui-cleanup/P1-VISUAL-STATE-SPEC.md sections 2, 3, 5.1, 5.2, 7, 8, 9 (the accepted P1, M5-T114) and its mockup frames S-D/S-M/C-D/C-M in P1-mockups.html (FOLLOW THE SPEC where the mockup under-renders - DB-083 a-i); docs/design/ui-cleanup/disclosure-ledger-a.json rows AD01-AD28, AC01-AC11, M01-M13, SH-01/02/05/10/15 (each row's protected meaning, progressive destination, accessibility and print path, and test owner); docs/design/ui-cleanup/P0-RECONCILIATION.md section 2 (the live route/state map, rows 4, 6, 18); docs/UI_DEEP_DIVE_ASSESSMENT.md section 14, P2 row (exit-gate scenarios); docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md DB-083 (b), (f), (i).

EXIT-GATE SCENARIOS (binding; each covered by a unit test and, where the journey needs it, the e2e spec): keyboard and touch; no auto-pick; manual fallback keeps the typed text; every error/retry category; a delayed PLUTO result without a CTA shift; invalid or missing BBL (the four lib/bbl.ts errors); no WebGL; multiple or invalid parcel; absent source.

LEDGER PROOF (binding; D-086-R003): the report lists every AD/AC/M/SH row whose rendering you touched as before -> after with the row id and the protected meaning, and names the test that proves it; a row's existing test owner keeps passing or is updated in scope with the reason. Nothing is dropped; meaning-changing copy is NOT adopted (the P1 meaning-change register stays open).

SCOPE DISCIPLINE (binding): ArchitectEntry.tsx - edit ONLY the PropertySearch block and the search view; every other part byte-unchanged. architect.css - only the search/confirm/autocomplete/map selectors. lib/* (disclaimer.ts, coverage.ts, bbl.ts and the other returned-contract helpers) are READ-ONLY.

CODE-GRAPH NAVIGATION BLOCK (D-066-R001; graph REGENERATED at the wave-1 seam, 844 files / 18356 nodes / 7841 edges): AddressResolutionScreen / AddressConfirmCard / LotOutlineMap are rendered from ArchitectEntry.tsx (PropertySearch) and PropertyOverview.tsx (LotOutlineMap) - PropertyOverview.tsx is READ-ONLY here; AddressAutocomplete.tsx is used by ArchitectEntry; the e2e specs confirm-journey, lot-outline, a11y-announcements and responsive-a11y walk this flow. Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` before sweeps; graph ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in actual source.

DISCOVERY ROUTING (D-069, binding): out-of-scope product/domain/defect findings go in the report's DISCOVERIES section - never fixed in-packet; the orchestrator records them in docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md at the seam.
outputs: apps/web/src/components/address/* - the P2 search/recovery + confirm-card + map-state presentation
apps/web/src/components/architect/AddressAutocomplete.tsx and the PropertySearch block of ArchitectEntry.tsx
unit tests under components/address/__tests__ and components/architect/__tests__, and the four e2e specs
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (one search/recovery area): suggestions with keyboard + touch and no auto-pick; the BBL alternative is a native <details>; the manual fallback keeps the typed text and names the missing fields; each typed error category renders its own recovery action and is announced once; tests per category.
AS-2 (identity comparison): entered vs matched vs PLUTO representative address stay distinct on the confirm card; equal ids collapse to one line; tests for both.

AS-3 (stable action area): a delayed PLUTO / record-address result never shifts Continue (a test with a deferred promise asserts the CTA position/identity is unchanged); city warnings stay verbatim above Continue.

AS-4 (map states): rendered, unavailable, no WebGL, multiple/invalid parcel and basemap-only failure are distinct, truthful states; a basemap failure never erases a working parcel; the 'Approximate - reference only' line and the BBL identity survive without the map.

AS-5 (preservation): the section-29 text only via REQUIRED_DISCLAIMER; no-guess matching and the optional record-address behaviour unchanged; the environment badge + review line visible at phone width; no permitted/approved/maximum-allowed wording; the ledger proof table covers every touched row.

AS-6 (scope + CI): exactly the allowed paths; zero new dependencies; no backend change; PropertySearch-only edits in ArchitectEntry.tsx; the web unit + e2e CI jobs are green on the pushed harvest head (the orchestrator pushes; the producer marks web results [PREDICTED]).
